items.name: base
items.title: Manga base
items.description: Shared foundation for every mangacn item: ink/paper/stamp-red tokens mapped onto shadcn variables (dark mode is the negative), a webtoon theme under data-theme="webtoon", screentone utilities (tone-10/20/35/50, tone-lines, tone-cross, tone-fade-r/l/t/b), speed-lines and focus-lines backgrounds, tone-shadow (offset screentone, never a blur), ink-fill, focus-ink, border-ink, shape-burst, edge-jagged and stepped 12 fps animations (animate-impact, -shake, -pop, -spin-steps, -draw, -enter, -sfx, -wiggle, -tone-flicker). Installed automatically as a dependency of every other item; install it alone to restyle stock shadcn/ui.
items.docs: mangacn base installed. Tones: tone-10|20|35|50, tone-lines, tone-cross, tone-fade-r|l|t|b. Energy: speed-lines, focus-lines. Ink: border-ink, ink-fill, focus-ink, tone-shadow (needs a positioned element). Webtoon theme: add data-theme="webtoon" to <html>. Fonts: set --font-manga-body, --font-manga-letter, --font-manga-sfx.

items.name: font-body
items.title: Font: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next
items.description: Reading face for body text and form fields (SIL OFL). Sets --font-manga-body. Installed by base.

font.family: 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next Variable', 'Atkinson Hyperlegible Next', sans-serif

items.name: font-lettering
items.title: Font: Patrick Hand SC
items.description: Hand-lettering face for titles, buttons and badges (SIL OFL). Sets --font-manga-letter. Installed by base.

items.name: font-sfx
items.title: Font: Dela Gothic One
items.description: Very heavy face for onomatopoeia, covers Latin and katakana (SIL OFL). Sets --font-manga-sfx. Installed by base.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Button. Variants: default (ink flat, speed lines on hover), outline, tone (screentone fill), ghost, link (wavy underline), destructive (stamp red, jagged edge), shout (burst shape for the one call to action on a page). Sizes sm, default, lg, icon. Adds loading (turning focus lines, aria-busy) and fullWidth. Pressing shows a 2px offset and an impact frame.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/button". It wraps your own components/ui/button, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/manga/button"

<Button variant="shout" size="lg">Start!</Button>
<Button variant="outline" loading>Saving</Button>

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows turning focus lines, sets aria-busy, disables the button.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Input. 2px ink line that thickens to 3px on focus, italic placeholder, fine line when read-only, dashed line + light tone when disabled, and an error look on aria-invalid (stamp red, serrated bottom edge, "!" mark). Sizes via inputSize: sm, default, lg.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/input". It wraps your own components/ui/input, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/manga/input"

<Input placeholder="Pen name" />
<Input aria-invalid defaultValue="reader@" />

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Checkbox. Square ink box; checked is an ink flat with a brush check that draws itself in three frames; indeterminate is a thick bar; disabled is dashed with a light tone; aria-invalid turns it stamp red. Hover adds a tone, press shows an impact frame.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/checkbox". It wraps your own components/ui/checkbox, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/manga/checkbox"

<label className="flex items-center gap-3">
  <Checkbox defaultChecked /> Notify me
</label>

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Switch. Square track: screentone when off, ink flat when on, with a square paper thumb. Dashed when disabled, stamp red line on aria-invalid.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/switch". It wraps your own components/ui/switch, so Radix and Base UI both work.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Badge in lettering type. Variants: default (ink flat), outline, tone (screentone), destructive (stamp red, jagged), burst ("NEW!" star) and stamp (tilted red stamp). Optional square status dot; icons via data-icon.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/badge". It wraps your own components/ui/badge, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/manga/badge"

<Badge variant="burst">New!</Badge>
<Badge variant="outline" dot>Live</Badge>

props.name: dot
props.description: Square status dot before the label.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Skeleton: light screentone that flickers in steps instead of pulsing in opacity. Shapes: text, avatar (square frame), panel (manga panel), block. SkeletonCard composes a card placeholder.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/skeleton". It wraps your own components/ui/skeleton, so Radix and Base UI both work.

items.name: sonner
items.title: Toast (Sonner)
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Sonner Toaster: 3px panel with a screentone shadow, stepped entrance, lettering titles, ink marks for success / info / warning / error, turning focus lines while loading, a shake on error. ToastSfx adds an optional onomatopoeia as the toast icon.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/sonner". It wraps your own components/ui/sonner, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Toaster, toast, ToastSfx } from "@/components/ui/manga/sonner"

<Toaster />

toast.success("Subscribed!")
toast("Level up!", { icon: <ToastSfx>DON!</ToastSfx> })

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Card as a comic panel: 3px frame and an offset screentone shadow. Variants: default, bleed (first image runs to the edges), tilted (slanted panel), splash (no frame, focus lines), beta (ink flat). interactive lifts it on hover; selected adds a double ink frame. All Card parts are re-exported.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/card". It wraps your own components/ui/card, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Card, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/card"

<Card variant="tilted">
  <CardHeader><CardTitle>Chapter 12</CardTitle></CardHeader>
  <CardContent>The long night.</CardContent>
</Card>

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Tabs. Variants: index (chapter dividers, active tab is an ink flat), underline (thick ink line), pills (boxed tabs on a light tone). Works horizontal and vertical; disabled tabs are dashed with a light tone.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/tabs". It wraps your own components/ui/tabs, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/tabs"

<Tabs variant="index" defaultValue="v1">
  <TabsList>
    <TabsTrigger value="v1">Vol. 1</TabsTrigger>
    <TabsTrigger value="v2">Vol. 2</TabsTrigger>
  </TabsList>
  <TabsContent value="v1">…</TabsContent>
</Tabs>

props.name: variant
props.description: Set on <Tabs>; lists and triggers follow.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Dialog: centred 3px panel with a screentone shadow over a screentone overlay, opening on an impact frame (no fade, no blur). Sizes sm, default, lg, full. DialogBody adds a scrolling region that keeps the shadow outside. All Dialog parts are re-exported.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/dialog". It wraps your own components/ui/dialog, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Dialog, DialogTrigger, DialogContent, DialogTitle } from "@/components/ui/manga/dialog"

<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger>Open</DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent size="sm"><DialogTitle>Leave the chapter?</DialogTitle></DialogContent>
</Dialog>

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Manga-styled wrapper around your shadcn Tooltip as a mini speech bubble with an ink tail that follows the side. Variants: speech and thought (cloud, two trailing circles). Pops in over two frames.
items.docs: Import from "@/components/ui/manga/tooltip". It wraps your own components/ui/tooltip, so Radix and Base UI both work.

meta.usage:
import { Tooltip, TooltipTrigger, TooltipContent } from "@/components/ui/manga/tooltip"

<Tooltip>
  <TooltipTrigger>Hover me</TooltipTrigger>
  <TooltipContent variant="thought">Maybe tomorrow.</TooltipContent>
</Tooltip>

items.name: speech-bubble
items.title: Speech Bubble
items.description: Manga speech bubble drawn in SVG at its real size, with real text inside. Variants: speech, thought (cloud), shout (spikes), whisper (dashed), narration (caption box), electronic (zigzag), wobbly (trembling). The tail points to top, bottom, start or end, aligned start/center/end, or none. BubbleGroup chains bubbles with narrow necks. Borderless in the webtoon theme.

meta.usage:
import { SpeechBubble, BubbleGroup } from "@/components/manga/speech-bubble"

<SpeechBubble variant="shout" tail="bottom" tailAlign="end">Get down!</SpeechBubble>

items.name: screentone
items.title: Screentone
items.description: Screentone as a component: dots, lines, cross-hatching or noise, with density, angle and cell size, and a stepped (never smooth) fade toward any side. Use it as a background behind content (text gets a paper knockout) or as a layer over art. Coloured by --tone-ink; soft colour flats in the webtoon theme.

meta.usage:
import { Screentone } from "@/components/manga/screentone"

<Screentone density={35} fade="bottom" className="h-48">Night falls</Screentone>

props.name: as
props.description: Behind children or overlaid on the parent.

items.name: speed-lines
items.title: Speed Lines
items.description: Emphasis lines drawn in SVG at the real size: focus (radial concentration lines with an empty centre and a movable origin) or motion (tapered parallel lines at any direction). Density control, optional stepped animation (off with reduced motion). Children sit on top with a paper knockout, ideal for SFX.
